title: Senior Cloud Engineer/Lead – Multi-Cloud Platform
description:
**Position**
 Senior Cloud Engineer/Lead – Multi\-Cloud Platform
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Cloud Platform Engineering team responsible for building, securing, automating, and operating a modern multi\-cloud platform. The successful candidate will play a key role in designing and managing enterprise\-scale cloud infrastructure across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), while driving automation, security, reliability, scalability, and platform standardization.
   

  

 Shift Timing
   

  

 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM IST
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, operate, and troubleshoot secure, highly available cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and OCI.
* Manage cloud networking, VPC/VCN design, DNS, routing, load balancing, IAM, and cloud governance services.
* Support production environments through incident response, root cause analysis, remediation, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Establish multi\-cloud architecture standards, best practices, operational procedures, and reusable platform components.
* Collaborate with Platform Engineering, SRE, DevOps, Security, and Application Engineering teams.


**Cloud Automation \& Infrastructure as Code**
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform and CloudFormation.
* Develop reusable Terraform modules and self\-service infrastructure frameworks.
* Automate provisioning, configuration management, compliance, patching, access management, and operational workflows.
* Create automation solutions using Python, Bash, and PowerShell scripts.


**Identity \& Access Management**
* Implement and support enterprise IAM solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, Ping Identity, PingFederate, AWS IAM, and IAM Identity Center.
* Configure and troubleshoot complex SSO, Federation, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, authentication, authorization, and user provisioning.
* Implement least\-privilege access controls and support governance, reviews, and compliance requirements.


**Systems Administration \& Security**
* Administer Linux and Windows Server environments including hardening, patching, monitoring, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Support cloud security initiatives including secrets management, certificates, encryption, TLS/SSL, and vulnerability remediation.
* Perform security assessments and partner with security teams to reduce infrastructure and IAM risk.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure, Systems Engineering, DevOps, or Platform Engineering.
* 3\+ years of technical leadership or people leadership experience.
* Strong production experience with at least two major cloud platforms and preferably all three AWS, GCP, and OCI.
* Expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code methodologies.
* Strong Linux and Windows administration experience.
* Deep understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Routing, Firewalls, Load Balancing, Proxies, and TLS/SSL.
* Experience with enterprise IAM and modern authentication technologies.
* Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, cloud security, and complex production troubleshooting.


**Technical Skills**
* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Terraform Modules
* AWS Services: EKS, VPC, S3, IAM, IAM Identity Center, Route53, CloudFront, Lambda, CloudWatch, Organizations
* GCP Services: GKE, VPC, IAM, Cloud DNS
* OCI Services: OKE, VCN, IAM
* IAM \& Authentication: Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, Ping Identity, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, Federation, MFA
* Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, EKS, GKE, OKE
* Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell
* Observability: Datadog, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana
* Configuration Management: Ansible
* Security: IAM, Secrets Management, Certificates, Encryption, Cloud Security
* Networking: DNS, Routing, VPN, Firewalls, Proxies, Load Balancing, TCP/IP, TLS/SSL


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS Solutions Architect, AWS SysOps, AWS Security Specialty, GCP, or OCI certifications.
* Experience with Kubernetes platforms and enterprise cloud landing zones.
* Experience with AWS Control Tower, Organizations, SCPs, and governance frameworks.
* Experience with GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Harness, and modern CI/CD platforms.
* Experience working in large\-scale enterprise and multi\-account multi\-cloud environments.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Build reliable, secure, and automated multi\-cloud platforms at scale.
* Reduce operational effort through automation and standardization.
* Improve infrastructure self\-service capabilities for engineering teams.
* Enhance cloud security, governance, IAM controls, and platform consistency.
* Act as a technical mentor and subject matter expert for cloud and platform engineering initiatives.


**Why Join The Team**
* Work on a modern cloud platform supporting global products and services.
* Drive strategic infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives.
* Influence enterprise networking standards, governance, and architecture.
* Work alongside Cloud, Security, SRE, Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering experts.


**Location:**
 IN\-GJ\-Ahmedabad, India\-Ognaj (eInfochips)
   

  

**Time Type**
 Full time
   

  

**Job Category**
 Engineering Services
